scope: Editable saved brand context and brand workspace using the existing theme; no new provider account or paid research call.

isolatedBrowser: Saved-brand overview with 132 associated reports, one project, one file, one saved workflow, one existing conversation and paused automatic rule
Conflicting edit rejected with draft retained
Explicit reload disables fields while waiting; refreshed revision can be saved
Revised name/market/audience/context retained; automatic monitoring remains paused
New research prefilled with website and revised context without launching a report
Files and workflows open with the brand filter selected
New chat selects brand and retains it on reload
Existing saved chat retains the original brand snapshot
Full brand report library includes all 132 associated reports

schema.forward: Add profiles.revision with default 1; existing fields/IDs remain unchanged.
schema.rollback: Older application code can continue creating/reading profiles; retain the additive revision column. Revert source without dropping user records.
schema.atomicity: Profile revision and managed-rule inputs update in one D1 transaction; simulated second-write failure rolls both back.

limits: Revision numbers prevent lost updates; no complete brand edit-history or restore facility is included.
Workspace previews show latest 10 records; full report and file views are linked.
Only explicitly brand-associated records are counted; counts are not market measurements.
New briefs/chats use revised context; saved workflow templates/manual monitors and prior reports/chats/pitches keep captured inputs.
A global brand selection spanning every independent view and shared-team permissions remain pending.
